title: JMAP API has no authentication enforcement
description: mail/server.rs:60-99: /jmap/session and /jmap/api accept requests without any auth check. AuthConfig (config.rs:53-61) is loaded but never consulted. Any unauthenticated network client can read all articles, create posts, and modify flags. Setting auth.required=true in config creates a false sense of security since it is ignored. Fix: implement and enforce HTTP Basic Auth or bearer token against AuthConfig.users before the JMAP dispatch.
